mechanism: Prochlorperazine may increase atovaquone metabolism via CYP3A4 induction, potentially reducing atovaquone bioavailability; additionally, both drugs can cause CNS depression and prochlorperazine may lower seizure threshold in immunocompromised patients.
action: Monitor atovaquone efficacy closely; consider alternative antiemetic if possible, or ensure adequate atovaquone dosing and monitor for treatment failure, especially in PCP prophylaxis/treatment.
